teaser: What does a person look like who was built to lead and built to notice everyone else first? You carry life path 1, the pioneer's path, inside an ISFJ, the steady keeper of small details. The 1 asks for an original move, made alone if it has to be. The ISFJ in you would rather make that move inside a structure someone already trusts. The pairing shows up as the quiet manager who redesigns the whole system but changes the schedule one week at a time, so no one has to notice the redesign happened until it already works.
excerpt: The coffee gets made the way the other person likes it, every time, without being asked twice.
